transcript.text: Now querying revenue for FY2025 (2025-02-01 to 2026-01-31), completed orders only, amount-discount, in cents, then convert to USD.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount - discount) AS net_cents, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM memory.bench.orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00'
